locationIdentity: Chapel Hill, North Carolina, United States; reject the same-name Queensland and Tennessee entities

studies.name: Carolina Abecedarian Project trial
studies.description: An early-childhood randomized study in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, recruiting four cohorts born in 1972–1976. Its first phase evaluated enriched center-based childcare through age five.
studies.scope: These are source-reported recruitment/study counts, not outcome-specific sample sizes. School-age treatment used a separate randomization and must not be conflated with the early-childhood assignment.

studies.name: Carolina Approach to Responsive Education trial
studies.description: An early-childhood randomized study in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, recruiting two cohorts born in 1978–1980. Its initial arms included center-based childcare, family education and control conditions.
studies.scope: The life-cycle economic paper pools the center-based arm with ABC, excluding CARE's home-visiting-only arm. The full trial is distinct from the analysis subset; do not assign all 65 families to that pooled sample.

analysisScope: Pooled first-phase ABC and CARE center-based treatment versus their randomized controls; not an independent third trial. Control children could attend alternative formal childcare.
publicationStatus: Prepared; live type/location/design validation and submission pending
